Scope: playgrounds at three locations (Qassim Oasis, Hail and Tabuk Industrial City), with civil, architectural, electrical, mechanical and landscape works and general site works, including air domes at Qassim and Tabuk and a toilet building at each site.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (weekly report, Physical Progress sheet). At 08-Nov-2026 the project is 82.22% complete against 87.77% planned, behind by 5.55% (SPI 0.94). It gained 2.16% this week against 2.31% planned, so the gap widened slightly.

The schedule now finishes the project 76 days after the contract date. The P6 update (data date 06-Nov-2026) and the weekly report both forecast handover on 02-Mar-2027 against the contract completion date of 16-Dec-2026, with −64.8 days of float; last week the forecast was 23-Feb-2027. 176 of the 284 open activities have negative float and 36 activities have failed to start. The air domes are furthest behind: Qassim 39.96% against 87.01% planned and Tabuk 35.13% against 81.77%, with no progress for the fourth week running.

The weekly report gives “Complete construction” as 13-Feb-2026, a date already past. P6 finishes the construction stage on 10-Feb-2027 at Qassim, 27-Dec-2026 at Hail and 13-Feb-2027 at Tabuk, so the intended date is probably 13-Feb-2027. The handover forecast moved from 23-Feb-2027 to 02-Mar-2027 this week, the third weekly slip in a row (07-Feb, 14-Feb, 23-Feb, then 02-Mar-2027). Of the contractual milestones, only the toilet building (+5.5 days) and the playground works (+9.1 days) keep positive float.

Data notes

  • Progress figures are the weekly report's physical progress (effort), weighted by 33,340 budgeted man-hours. 10,000 of them (30%) sit on the time-based “Project Durations” activities (management line), which earn progress as time passes and stand at 86.43% (8,643 man-hours). Without them the project would be 80.42% complete against 88.34% planned, behind by 7.92% rather than 5.55%. The two air domes carry only 1,116 man-hours each (6.7% of all man-hours) although they are 23.4% of the contract value, so their stoppage hardly moves the physical %. By comparison, invoiced and FIR value to date are both 4,244,771 SAR, 11.9% of the contract value. This week's files do not change this; the report still shows the contractor's physical % as given. The report's dashboard shows cost-based progress labelled as actual; this report uses physical progress only.
  • The report states “Current Contract Weeks: 0 of 0”, so the week number is counted from site handover (17-Feb-2026): 264 days, week 37.
  • The “Weekly Physical Progress” columns hold 79.55% planned and 71.94% earned, which match neither week's to-date figures. Progress this week is taken as the change in to-date progress since the 01-Nov-2026 report.
  • All major quantities are identical in the 18-Oct, 25-Oct, 01-Nov and 08-Nov-2026 reports, although interlock, tartan, curbstone and irrigation work was reported; the sheet appears not to have been updated.
  • Man-hours by site: Tabuk toilet building still shows 0 of 1,708 man-hours earned with only 40 planned, and Tabuk closeout has no budget but 76.72 man-hours earned.
  • The milestone sheet gives complete construction as 13-Feb-2026 with 0 days change, and complete mobilisation as 14-Apr-2026 against 18-Mar-2026 with 0 days change.
  • Procurement: the summary has 8 of 57 materials on site, unchanged for three weeks, while the P6 delivery activities are 70–95% complete. The procurement log has no delivered quantities or dates.
  • Invoices: the summary shows 0 submitted invoices while the log lists IPC-01 to IPC-03. Paid invoices (4,348,338 SAR) exceed the gross submitted value although none is PM-approved. The FIR summary total now equals the gross invoiced value exactly (it was 3,688,354 last week) and lists FIR-0630 twice. The dashboard's penalties of −469,477 combine advance payment recovery and deductions.
  • Manpower and safety: the dashboard shows 46 manual workers while the Manpower sheet has 65 for November; the safety statistics give 10,000 safe man-hours this week against 11,640 man-hours worked, while both cumulative totals are 129,170. The DB sheet still holds another project's data (HAL1-02-005).
  • The P6 update has a data date of 06-Nov-2026, against 08-Nov-2026 for the weekly report; 131 in-progress activities have a finish date before the data date. Three PDFs are named MLTX-05-047 although they belong to MLTX-02-003.
  • The contractor forecast in the Physical-Chart Data sheet starts at 0 in February, 365 man-hours below the actual, so it stays slightly below actual until October.
